utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I might come by for a little while, Leo, but I can’t stay long. I’m a bit tied up right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’s fine—come by if you can, even briefly, and bring any basic tools you’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I can bring a few basic tools and stop in for a bit if I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa’s the one organizing it, yes, but I’m still waiting on her final times tonight before I can confirm the exact start.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, can you let me know once Rosa confirms the exact start time, and we’re definitely meeting by the community shed?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, I’ll let you know as soon as Rosa sends the final time tonight, and the plan I’ve been sharing is to meet by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m headed to Maple Street first, Rosa, and I’ll help however needed after that. I don’t have the exact start time yet, so let’s check with Opal.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that’s a big help. Just remember the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and yes, let’s check with Opal on the start time.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Sunday at the community center—I’ll plan for Maple Street first and check with Opal on the start time before I head out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hana, I’ve got Gus confirmed for nine with the ladder and drill, and Rey will keep the list in order, so we should have the small fixes sorted before we start.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli—that helps; before we move ahead, can you confirm the date and location for the repair drive, and whether the van brakes are definitely on the list?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: It’s set for Saturday at the community shed on Maple, and yes, put the van brakes on the list so we can place them after the small fixes once Gus arrives at nine.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect—I’ll put Faye on the midday shift at check-in, unless Maple Street still needs an extra hand by then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Mara—that keeps Faye set at midday check-in, with Maple Street as the fallback if Sam says they need her there.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good—I’ll keep Faye on midday check-in and switch her to Maple Street only if Sam says they’re short by then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in for the van brakes first, but I still need Opal to confirm the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the time—if Opal confirms it, could you remind me where to head again? I’m still coming, even without the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah—van brakes first, and I think Maple Street’s the first stop, but let’s have Opal confirm so I don’t send you wrong.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry, Ira, I’m still catching up too—I only know we’re planning the repair drive, but I haven’t heard a confirmed date or details yet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No worries—if you hear anything firm, text me while I’m out; I’ll help once I’m back.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do—I’m still waiting on the solid details too, but I’ll text you as soon as I hear anything firm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, how many people are actually confirmed right now for the repair drive, and are you bringing tools or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still just repeating the plan, Mina—we’re meeting by the community shed, and Oren’s coming to help even without his toolbox. I’ll text everyone if the volunteer count or supplies get firm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, but I need a real count, Vik—can you confirm whether we’re still only at about three for sure, and what are you personally bringing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad it’s moving along, but I’d feel better once Mara confirms what’s actually in Noah’s toolbox and who’s covering tape, screws, and gloves.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Same here—I’ve been connecting people across the groups, but I’m waiting on the confirmed toolbox and supply rundown before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That makes sense—could you ask Mara to send the confirmed list as soon as she hears, so we can see what still needs covering before the weekend?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard bits and pieces from Mara, so I’m still not totally sure—do you know if it’s definitely still on this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, from what I’ve heard, yes, it’s still on this weekend, and Mara’s keeping a list while I ask around so we’ve got the basics covered.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps, thanks—I’ve mostly been hearing things second-hand, so I’ll probably check with Jules or Sam before I bring anything.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m keeping the list in order now, and we’ll start with the small fixes first. If you need the latest schedule details, Rosa has them.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rey—before we slot anything in, can we confirm the date and location, and make sure the carpool van brakes stay high priority since I need it safe around school drop-off and pickup this week?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah—let’s confirm the date and spot with Rosa first, and I’ll keep the van brakes at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—good, thanks, Gus. If you’re still coming a little before nine with the ladder and tool kit, I’ll try to remember the toolbox and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ll be there a little before nine with the ladder and tool kit, so we should be set.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—good, then I’ll head over with the toolbox if I don’t get sidetracked again.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Dane — quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, not Saturday on the front porch. If you can help spread the word, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Rosa — sorry I’m late again, but I’ve got it now: Sunday at the community center, and I can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — that helps a lot. If you hear of anyone who still needs details or help getting their things there, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m checking with Opal on the exact time, but the van brakes should be first once that’s set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds right—while Opal confirms timing, keep 12 Maple and 18 Oak on the list, and don’t count on Noah for tape, screws, or gloves yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep—keep 12 Maple and 18 Oak on the list, and I won’t count on Noah for supplies till that’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell—I’ll come by around nine with the ladder and drill, and I can help with setup too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Gus—that sounds right in line with what I’ve been hearing. I’m still getting updates second-hand, so I’ll check with Jules to make sure nine’s the plan.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Nell—just let me know if anything shifts, and I’ll still plan on bringing the ladder and drill.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Any update on the repair drive yet? I’m still out, but if it turns urgent, text me and I’ll head over.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Gus is confirmed for around nine with his ladder and drill, so I’m keeping the list in order and starting with the small fixes first. If anything turns urgent, I’ll text you right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, thanks—having Gus and the tools lined up helps a lot. Keep me posted, and if anything urgent comes up, I’ll swing by as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Before I commit, can you confirm who’s actually leading it and whether the start time is 10, not 9?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still waiting on Hana and the others to lock the logistics, so I can’t confirm the lead or whether it starts at 10 yet. I need to work around school drop-off and pickup, so once the date and location are set I can commit.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, then I’m not committing yet—please let me know once the lead and exact start time are actually confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Pia, Rosa’s organizing it, and I’ve got the tape, markers, and boxes ready at the community shed for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot, but I’m still worried about the screws and gloves if Noah’s toolbox ends up light—has Rosa got someone covering those too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t heard Rosa confirm screws or gloves yet, but the shed’s set with the tape, markers, and boxes, and I can check with her before people arrive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can come by Maple Street for a little while and help with the fence panels, but I may need to leave early.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a big help, Uli—let’s start with the fence panels on Maple Street, and whatever time you can give is appreciated.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright, I’ll come by and do what I can for a bit.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—if you can swing by and help out for a bit, we’d really appreciate it, and feel free to tell anyone else too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can stop by for a bit, and I’ve already got Maple Street’s fence panels marked as the first stop. I’ll keep pointing folks there unless Sam reports we need to shift the next crew.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Opal—thanks for jumping in and helping steer people to Maple Street. Keep me posted if Sam shifts the crew, and please keep spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, do you know how many people are actually confirmed for this weekend, or are we still just talking about maybes?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’re still mostly at the maybe stage—I haven’t gotten a confirmed headcount yet, and Opal’s the one tracking who’s actually in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then can you check with Opal today and get me a firm count, plus who’s still a maybe?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Tess, I’ve got Faye penciled in for midday check-in and Gus coming early with the ladder and tool kit—can you tell me what still needs organizing on your end?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, on my end I’m still asking around about the basics—mostly extra tools, spare parts, and who’s firmly confirmed versus still a maybe, so I’ll pass along anything useful for your list.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess—that helps; if you can send me the firm confirms and any tool or spare-part gaps first, I’ll fold them into the repair drive list right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: We’ve got the list organized for the small fixes first, and Gus should be by around nine with his ladder and drill.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—nine, right. Okay, that helps; I’ll try to bring the toolbox over in a bit once I get myself sorted.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Noah — that’ll help a lot. If you need the schedule or want me to add anything to the list, just tell me when you come by.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oren, before we move on, can you confirm the date, location, and which repairs the drive will actually cover?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I’m a bit fuzzy on the date, but it’s the repair drive over by the shed, and I think it’s mostly little fixes like bikes, lamps, and toasters.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks—that helps, but before we tell anyone, can you check the exact date and confirm whether the shed is the final location and that those repair types are definitely the list?
